description: Validation and test logits of the CIFAR-100 scoring routes, re-exported from the released checkpoints and BN banks (model-assets-v2) on one RTX 5090 in FP32 with TF32 disabled. One .npz per route with test_logits, test_labels, test_ids, test_ce, test_pred, validation_logits, validation_labels, validation_ids, validation_ce, validation_pred; summary_<family>.jsonl lists the routes with their test and validation CE and accuracy and the difference to the recorded test score; export_*.log are the export logs.

families.ext_0: C-conf, F-arch, A-conf and A-cal cohorts, shard 0 of 3 (extension352 loaders)
families.native42_0: the six replication starts C'1-3 and F'1-3 (native42 loader)
